name: Adversarial Worst-Case Warning
description: Follows the S12 strategy by explicitly warning that the test cases may contain dense constraint subgraphs among small identifiers that do not form a failing subset, hiding the only valid subset among the largest identifiers. This breaks the models' reliance on early-exit nested loops by forcing them to realize such an approach will TLE, pushing them toward globally efficient algorithms like bitwise adjacency intersection, which they often struggle to implement correctly.
